messages:
nina: Heads-up — onboarding orion-lite-int8 on the vertical-JA OCR->translate flow and seeing furigana (ruby) annotations being dropped or attached to the wrong base character; sometimes a U+FFFC object-replacement appears. BLEU down ~5.6 pts on ja-vertical-ruby-dev.

yasmin: U+FFFC? that's our placeholder when detok sees an unexpected surrogate or control. Can you paste a tiny repro + delta?

nina: Minimal repro (fp16 baseline -> orion-lite-int8):
```
input: "
"  # real input is three short lines: kanji with ruby on first line
baseline: "先生（せんせい）。 次の行。"
int8: "先生。  次の行."  # furigana lost and odd replacement
```
BLEU: baseline 34.1 -> int8 28.5 on ja-vertical-ruby-dev (n=1.3k). Exact-match drop ~11%.

troy: Any tokenizer/tracer output? maybe the merged BPE handles ruby markers differently after quant kernel selection.

nina: Tokenizer trace shows extra 0xFFFC id inserted between base and ruby tokens only on int8 run. Example token ids near break: [902, 0xFFFC, 1203]. Raw bytes around: e5 a4 a7 e3 83 95 e3 83 aa e3 82 b0 e3 83 8a 0a.

yasmin: Could be the fused merge+cache packing we enabled for orion-lite-int8 — if the packer treats the ruby span as a separate segment it might inject a placeholder when misaligned. Does forcing reference merge + deterministic cache reproduce?

nina: Quick A/B: forcing --ref-merge + --deterministic-cache restores baseline behavior; furigana preserved, BLEU back to 33.7. So it's likely the quant pack path.

dev-bot: Canary alert: orion-lite-int8 (canary-2) failed ja-vertical-ruby-detok (delta BLEU -5.6). Rolling back canary.

troy: Good signal. I'll bisect the pack/merge changes in the int8 kernel and inspect the segment-alignment logic when handling inline annotations (ruby/kanji spans). I'll add assert that a base token must not be separated from its annotation by a surrogate token after merge.

yasmin: Let's also add a small CI smoke: detok-roundtrip for ja-vertical-ruby samples on PRs that touch runtime pack/merge. Mark it required for canary promotion until fixed.

qa-bot: New job queued: ja-vertical-ruby-smoke (runs on runtime kernel PRs).

nina: Uploaded 40 failing examples + full tokenizer/detok traces to the issue (internal link). For now keep the canary rolled back; opt-out fused packer for vertical-JA in config.

troy: Plan: patch to add a packer-guard for annotation spans, add unit test that fuzzes ruby attachments under int8 kernels, and then re-run a limited canary.

nina: TL;DR: orion-lite-int8 pack/merge path breaks ruby (furigana) attachments on vertical Japanese OCR inputs; mitigation = disable fused pack/merge for vertical-ja, add unit tests and CI smoke, bisect and fix kernel alignment.
